annotations.text:
v3 direction: Paper.
Bright, generous, editorial. One teal accent per region. Sentences instead of chips. Every term (fit, spoke, resurface) has a tooltip; every screen has How this works with Kofi, Elena and Chiara as the example.

What changed from v2.1: Home replaces Today. People replaces Bench. Sources is new: drop anything, mailbox scan, Drive folder, Capture button, Slack export, teammates + hiring-manager link + Inbox.

For Mark to decide:
1. Team layer now (v3) or next (3.1)? The mockup shows it in.
2. Keep the Target as a side chart on People, or its own tab?
3. Serif headlines (Instrument Serif) or all sans?
4. Anything missing from Sources?
